scope: Bind offline inspection provenance to the file or stored revision actually read
behavior: Shows file name and size, or stored copy label, full identifier, revision and timestamp.
Captures metadata with the encrypted content read for that inspection. A later selection or stored revision cannot relabel an already opened result.
Clearing inspected data also removes source metadata. Local source metadata does not assert ledger authority.

unit.scope: Delayed browser read followed by selection change retains original copy/revision with real backup crypto, plus existing inspection and panel regression.

browser.scope: Desktop/mobile show actual selected filename and retain password-error, report/draft separation, clearing, offline and overflow checks.

release.scope: Normal web build/typecheck and release manifest after browser tests.

limits: Browser-copy storage is mocked in the delayed-read component test; browser E2E inspects a real selected encrypted file.
No full regression, container refresh or native-wallet ceremony in this increment. Previous runtime evidence remains tied to application revision 819eb1e.
